goal:
Show the repaint price before the user commits, and point the paint path at the paid board when the board reports schema 4.

WHY
The contract now charges 1 / 2 / 4 credits by how recently a cell was painted (contracts/paid-board/src/lib.rs Tunables::cost). The page still shows one flat price, so a drag over freshly painted cells silently costs up to 4x what the UI implied. That is the difference between a game and a trick.

SCOPE
- Read the rule from the chain, never re-implement it: `get_cell_cost(x,y)` per cell, `get_tunables()` for the legend thresholds. If those views fail, show 'price unavailable' and disable submit; never fall back to a guessed 1 credit.
- Per-cell affordance: on hover/tap show 'repaint N min ago · X credits' (or 'unpainted · 1 credit').
- Stroke total before submit: 'this stroke: N cells · M credits' computed from a batched read of each cell's cost. Mixed-age drags must show a mixed total.
- One-line legend in the DEFAULT view, not inside <details>: 'Fresh cells cost more to repaint. Wait an hour and it is 1 credit again.'
- Wire paint submission to the paid board only when get_board reports schema_version 4: draw(x,y,color) for a single cell, draw_many(cells) for a stroke, no deposit. The free schema-2 path stays unchanged.
- If credits are insufficient for the priced total, explain the shortfall before the gesture is submitted, not after the wallet call.

CONSTRAINTS
- Frontend only: web/src/**. No contract, palette, camera-math or wallet-key changes.
- Keep the existing all-or-nothing stroke behaviour; a rejected stroke must not leave partial chrome.
- Mobile: the per-cell cost must be reachable on touch (long-press or selection), not hover-only.

ACCEPTANCE
- A test that FAILS on 0a3e284: with schema 4 and a cell painted 2 minutes ago, the rendered stroke total equals cost x cells (not cells x 1).
- A test that the legend string is present outside any <details> element.
- A test that a get_cell_cost failure disables submit and shows 'price unavailable'.
- Existing 284 tests stay green; `cd web && npm run build` passes.

DO NOT
- Do not duplicate the tier thresholds in TypeScript constants.
- Do not change the contract to make the UI simpler.
notes: Depends on pay-schema4-cleanup (contract-meta accepting schema 4) being merged first; if it is not, accept schema 4 inside this task and delete the schema-3 mock path in the same PR.
